evidence: Modifies src/net_processing.cpp to refactor PeerManagerImpl::SendMessages(), the central P2P message dispatching and timeout loop.
rationale: Refactoring monolithic dispatch logic into isolated per-message helpers improves navigation and lock analysis in central P2P code, but introduces no behavioral changes. Author notes SendMessages() was 'hard to navigate and review' during net refactoring, and reviewers support being able to address smaller parts by name.
